title: Metabolomics Analysis and Saccharomyces cerevisiae Research Network
summary: This cluster revolves around the process of Metabolomics analysis, which utilizes various methods such as Capillary electrophoresis mass spectrometry, Gas chromatography mass spectrometry, Liquid chromatography mass spectrometry, and Nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy. Saccharomyces cerevisiae is a central organism in this cluster, with researchers Gao Xiaoli, Zhang Shengwei, and Ge Shanshan contributing to its conceptualization, data curation, and formal analysis, respectively. The organism has conserved pathways with human and exhibits mitochondrial dysfunction, retrograde signaling, and nitrogen metabolism. The Multidisciplinary Digital Publishing Institute publishes research related to Antioxidants, which is associated with Basel. The European Union funds the A4L_BRIDGE project, which is connected to this research network.
